_doc: P7: the pg_* flag overrides for assets/pack-inputs/hr_tiles.json. Merged by the legacy P7 packer together with the tile install (any pg name in hr_tiles.json is live: it must exist in every gate build's atlas, so it lands only with P2's real tiles). Rotation/mirror come from P6's tiles_pg.json (rot:true -> all + mirror); here only emission, water, the cross sprites and the Eyeball Lamp's glow. Plan 7.2.
